name: Piecewise Linear Ray Integration with Pre-integrated Lookup Table
aliases: Williams and Max piecewise linear luminance solution
definition: A method to evaluate the volume rendering integral for piecewise linear luminance and attenuation using a pre-computed 2D lookup table indexed by normalized variables, reducing computation compared to previous approaches.
summary: Piecewise Linear Ray Integration with Pre-integrated Lookup Table is a volume rendering method that uses a 2D lookup table to analytically solve integrals for linear luminance and attenuation profiles, offering higher accuracy than piecewise constant approximations.
